description: Defines an abstract base class 'CodeBase' for barcode representations in the PDFsharp library, including properties, methods, and calculations related to barcode positioning and validation.

classes.name: CodeBase
classes.description: Abstract class serving as the base for barcode implementations, managing properties like size, text, anchor, and direction, and providing methods for position calculations.

methods.name: CodeBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing barcode text, size, and direction.

methods.name: CheckCode
methods.description: Abstract method to validate barcode text in derived classes.

methods.name: CalcDistance
methods.description: Calculates positional vector between two anchor points based on size.
